title: Lay Her Gently in the Dust
description: Lay Her Gently in the Dust in Tonic Solfa to SPANISH HYMN, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 587 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Dirge for an Infant”.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens, six lines (7.7.7.7.7.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to SPANISH HYMN; any other Sevens, six lines tune fits them as well.
underlay: Lay her gen-tly in the dust; Griev-ous task, but oh! ye must! Hear the sen-tence, "earth to earth, Spir-it to im-mor-tal birth;" Youth-ful, gen-tle, un-de-filed, An-gels nur-ture now the child!

lines: Lay her gently in the dust;
Grievous task, but oh! ye must!
Bearing with her chains of love;
Not to draw her spirit back,
But to smooth her upward track:
Her, the youngest of thy fold,
With the Rock of Ages trust,
That which was enshrined in dust;
Rests she now her weary wings.
